meta.what: Out-of-sample check of the unit-7 refusal guards (G3 | G4 notice | G5 | G6, |N| < 2 exempt) on the 25 o2 Tenders of the fresh salted 50 (draw.json). Every block the 568 rule matched (served lot != null on an R2.0.8 award block of a CAN without lot sections of its own) was labelled by hand from the cached reads (o2_view.py / o2_compact.py; labels in o2_labels.py) BEFORE the rule was run; this file is the join.

labels.single_right: one lot, correctly placed (title/description agree with the lot, or value/winner agree)
labels.multi_lot_contract: one award for several lots (text, or value = a sum of several CN lots)
labels.wrong_other: on a lot that is not its lot for another reason (contract counter, CAN-only renumbering, mis-chained CAN)

observations: The only wrong Tender is 5416534 (CAN 18634900, 105 blocks): LN = CONTRACT_NUMBER = 1..105 is a contract counter, while the titles name the real pakiet and the CN numbers its 111 lots sequentially (Pakiet 16 poz 1-6 = LOT-16..21, ..., Pakiet 92 = LOT-111). Pakiet 15 is unawarded, so RES-1..14 are right by coincidence and RES-15..105 (91) sit on an earlier lot. This is the recorded 5051007 / 5267810 shape.

G4 (notice) fires on the whole CAN: 91/91 wrong caught, and the 14 coincidental rights refused - the deliberate cost the decision names (risk 3). No other guard fires anywhere else in o2: 0 of the other 146 right blocks on 24 Tenders are refused.

Latent G3 false positive seen (no effect here): "Pakiet 16 zad.1", "Pakiet 59 zad. 2", "Pakiet 88 zad.13" read as TWO designators {16, 1} because zad is a lot keyword and not a compound second half (POSITION_WORDS). Each names ONE CN lot (the CN describes LOT-16 as "Pakiet 16 - pozycja nr 1"). G3 fires on these 22 blocks; they are wrong anyway and G4 already refuses them, but on a CAN that printed the CN's own numbers (16..21) G3 would refuse 22 right blocks (G4 would not: the lot's own text carries both designators).
G5 and G6 fire nowhere in o2. No multi-lot contract and no residual wrong block in o2.
